S1: What would it take, to write your own destiny...
and not just hope to get lucky?
S2: How much control do we really have, over making our dreams real?
S3: Is what you're dreaming of, actually possible?
The less likely you believe it is, the harder it gets to make it real.
S4: There's never just one way to reach a future.
Look at your options, and pick the one that's best for you, right now.
S5: A big goal doesn't happen in an instant.
Then break each task, into something you can do today.
Think of it as one stair, in a very long staircase.
S6: And you don't do this once.
Your situation changes, so you come back to steps two and three...
S7: So, does this make you the author of your destiny?
If the effort is logical, and it makes sense, it takes you to a reality that would never exist, if you just drifted.
That's how the future gets written.
Every choice any of us makes, leads to a reality that wouldn't exist otherwise.
S8: Write your dream down today, and break it into steps you can actually take.
What's the one stair you'll take today?
